subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill descriptions get concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger selection move to a structured metadata contract instead?
rationale: Current source still preserves descriptions and can render them as model-visible selection cues, but current docs constrain descriptions to short one-line text and a separate open issue proposes structured trigger metadata, so automation should not choose the permanent skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics and routing behavior.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that current concise descriptions are intentional and close related partial wording PRs as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent skill-authoring docs and Skill Workshop history make this the strongest available owner for the wording-policy decision.
